div.p: This case-sensitive code system http://hl7.org/fhir/us/demographic-collect/CodeSystem/ahip-demo-disability-codes defines the following codes:

tr.td: Deafness or serious difficulty hearing because of a physical or mental health condition.
Blindness or serious difficulty seeing, even when wearing glasses, because of a physical or mental health condition.
Serious difficulty walking or climbing stairs because of a physical or mental health condition.
Serious difficulty concentrating, remembering, or making decisions because of a physical or mental health condition.
Difficulty dressing or bathing because of a physical or mental health condition.
Difficulty cooking for oneself because of a physical or mental health condition.
Difficulty feeding oneself because of a physical or mental health condition.
Difficulty using the toilet because of a physical or mental health condition.
Doing errands alone, such as shopping or visiting a doctor’s office
Difficulty doing errands alone, such as shopping or visiting a doctor's office, because of a physical or mental health condition.
Communicating or being understood using your usual language
Difficulty communicating or being understood using one's usual language because of a physical or mental health condition.
Understanding when someone speaks in your usual language
Difficulty understanding when someone speaks in one's usual language because of a physical or mental health condition.
